name: youtube-channels-mcp
description: YouTube channel stats (subscribers, exact total views, video count), recent videos and Shorts with views, channel comparisons, channels by topic, playlists and hashtags, through an Apify MCP server. No YouTube API key needed.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: Your Apify API token (Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations). Runs are billed to your Apify account at the Actor's pay-per-event prices plus platform usage.
